title: MiniMax H3 combines image, video and stereo audio generation in one model
friendlyTitle: MiniMax H3 can create video and sound together
summary: MiniMax launched H3, an omni-modal generation model that accepts mixed text, image, video and audio context and produces video with native stereo audio at up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds. The company says it plans to release model weights in the coming days, subject to applicable rules.
friendlySummary: H3 can use text, pictures, video and audio as instructions, then make short 2K videos with stereo sound. MiniMax says model weights should follow soon.
whyItMatters: A single model that can follow references across media could simplify advertising, product design and short-form production workflows that currently require several specialised tools. Availability, licensing and independent quality tests will matter before teams commit it to production.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Creators may need fewer separate tools to make short videos, adverts and product ideas. Check the licence, price and real-world quality before building a workflow around it.
